model_annotation: Figure 3(a) illustrates the inference time, measured in seconds, for different model sizes during batch size scaling. The x-axis represents the batch size, ranging from 0 to 300, with linear scale and tick labels spaced at intervals of 32, 64, 128, 256, and 300. The y-axis represents the inference time in seconds, with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 6.5, and tick labels spaced at intervals of 0.5. The plot displays three lines: a red line representing the inference time for the “Llama-1B” model, which begins at 0 seconds with an inference time of approximately 0.3 seconds and gradually increases to approximately 3.7 seconds at a batch size of 300; a green line representing the inference time for the “Mamba-1B” model, which starts at 0 seconds with an inference time of approximately 0.3 seconds and rises to approximately 2.6 seconds at a batch size of 300; and a blue line representing the inference time for the “Mamba-4B” model, which begins at 0 seconds with an inference time of approximately 0.3 seconds and reaches approximately 4.7 seconds at a batch size of 300.
